questions.question: Who has priority when you join a motorway from a slip road?
options: Vehicles joining from the slip road
questions.explanation: Match the speed of motorway traffic and give way before merging into a safe gap.

questions.question: If you miss your motorway exit, what must you do?
options: Carry on to the next exit
Stop and turn across the central reservation
questions.explanation: Never reverse or turn on a motorway; continue safely to the next junction.
